bio: Modern art meets rustic elements such as the terracotta-colour tiles and exposed beams in the stylish interior of this elegant villa. The verdant terrace is one of the prettiest in South Limburg! Hostess Kirsten greets diners with a warm welcome while chef Michael lets his take on contemporary French cuisine do the talking. Each dish is meticulously crafted with an eye for detail and a commitment to local sourcing. His set menu might feature Livar pork belly with a sweet potato cream, smoked almond and Espelette pepper crumble, tabbouleh and a subtly fiery nduja sauce that adds a touch of liveliness. This couple knows exactly how to pamper their guests!...
